filter.description: The translated filter that can be applied to the backend data model (ex: MlModel)

additionalFilter.description:
Additional filtering information that needs to be applied AFTER the true fetch has been applied.
This generally comes into consideration when the UI supports a filtering that is not immediately
appliable through the DB engine (ex: needs to be called as member functions on the instance)

additionalInclude.description: Additional include strings that need to be included to satisfy any post fetch filtering.

name: TranslatedFilter
